text: Inputs: cm_diseases(), cm_associations() (, RR, RD, conditional probability, phi, contingency tables, independent, unknown), cm_three_way(), cm_population(), cm_impacts(), cm_interactions(), cm_model() cm_analyses(). data: cm_read_inputs() reads CSV files data frames reports every problem ; cm_template() writes example files. Joint distribution feasibility: fit_joint(), combination_probs() check_feasibility(). Report quantiles, use exact ("simultaneous") method. (c = 0, e.g. independent diseases, formula reduces m flagged.) "heavy_tail": extreme draws dominate variance. Importance sampling may help come one region one input. exact method can also heavy-tailed sampled inputs make conflation matrix nearly singular. "imprecise": Monte Carlo standard error large relative mean. Use draws, Latin hypercube sampling. "non_finite": draws gave non-finite results rejected.
